rationale: Plausible and MISEV-aligned exploratory identity attribute with manufacturable analytics, supported by canonical guidance but lacking program-specific validation. Key risks (false positives from co-isolates, marker variability, assay artifacts, and translational uncertainty) and explicit evidence gaps (marker presence on MSC EVs, assay specificity/LOD vs lipoproteins/aggregates, stability through manufacturing/scale-up, and large-animal/clinical-matrix performance) justify proceeding to the targeted experiments and qualification described (orthogonal capture + particle correlation + protection + density controls). Ensure inclusion of rigorous negative controls, marker verification, assay LOD/specificity studies, and follow-up potency/biodistribution linkage; final acceptance criteria and marker selection remain human decisions.
